'''Justin Griswold All Around Perfect''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Justin Griswold]]
* '''Published:''' September 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327]]
* '''Strategy:''' All Around Perfect
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH All Around Perfect Griswold DS 1996.txt |Download]]
